title: Large client bundle from unused dependencies
summary: A JavaScript framework app ships large dependencies or unused code to most users.
rationale: Large bundles increase network transfer, parse/compile time, memory use, and carbon impact.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Analyze bundles, tree-shake, code-split, remove unused dependencies, and lazy-load route-specific code.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
